{{Short description|Greek mathematician}}
'''Panos Papasoglu''' ({{langx|el|Παναγιώτης Παπάζογλου}}; original name is also [[transliteration|transliterated]] in English as Panagiotis Papazoglou) is a [[Greece|Greek]] [[mathematician]],  Lecturer of Mathematics at the Mathematics Department of the [[University of Oxford]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. Panagiotis Papazoglou {{!}} Mathematical Institute|url=https://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/people/panagiotis.papazoglou|access-date=2021-05-20|website=www.maths.ox.ac.uk}}</ref> His main research interests are [[group theory]] and [[geometric group theory]].

He got his doctorate under [[Hyman Bass]] in [[Columbia University]] in 1993. Papasoglou taught at [[University of Paris XI]] until he returned to Greece in the early 2000s. He taught at the [[University of Athens]] until the late 2000s.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://noether.math.uoa.gr/academic-staff/section-of-algebra-geometry/tomeas-algebras-geometrias-en/view?set_language=en |title=Section of Algebra & Geometry — Τμήμα Μαθηματικών Πανεπιστήμιου Αθηνών |access-date=2009-03-23 |archive-date=2009-04-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090410143806/http://noether.math.uoa.gr/academic-staff/section-of-algebra-geometry/tomeas-algebras-geometrias-en/view?set_language=en |url-status=dead }}</ref>
